bodies: Towing and Recovery Association of America
NCBFAA Educational Institute with the National Association of Foreign-Trade Zones
FIATA with the NCBFAA Educational Institute

exams.name: Certified Automotive Fleet Manager
exams.blurb: Fleet management credential earned by passing eight discipline examinations spanning asset, financial, information, maintenance and risk management.

exams.name: Certified Automotive Fleet Specialist
exams.blurb: Intermediate fleet credential awarded after completing four of the eight CAFM discipline examinations covering core fleet operations topics.

exams.name: Certified Logistics Associate
exams.blurb: Foundational supply chain credential covering the logistics environment, safety, quality, teamwork and workplace computer systems.

exams.name: Certified Logistics Technician
exams.blurb: Mid-level warehouse credential on receiving, storage, order processing, packaging, inventory control, dispatch and tracking operations.

exams.name: FRA Blue Signal Protection Training
exams.blurb: Training under 49 CFR Part 218 on blue signal display and removal protecting workers servicing rolling equipment.

exams.name: FRA Roadway Worker Protection Training
exams.blurb: Annual training under Part 214 on on-track safety, working limits, train approach warning and job briefings for roadway workers.

exams.name: FRA Conductor Certification
exams.blurb: Federally required certification of freight and passenger conductors covering rules knowledge, skills testing and monitoring under Part 242.

exams.name: FRA Locomotive Engineer Certification
exams.blurb: Certification required to operate a locomotive, involving written examination, skills performance testing and periodic operational monitoring.

exams.name: FRA Track Inspector Qualification
exams.blurb: Qualification under the Track Safety Standards allowing an individual to inspect track, classify defects and authorise remedial action.

exams.name: Roadway Worker in Charge Qualification
exams.blurb: Qualification allowing a worker to establish and control on-track working limits and conduct job briefings for a roadway work group.

exams.name: National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners Certification Test
exams.blurb: Federal test qualifying clinicians to perform commercial driver physicals and issue medical examiner certificates under FMCSA standards.

exams.name: National Safety Council Defensive Driving Course
exams.blurb: Nationally recognised driver improvement course teaching collision avoidance, space management and hazard recognition for fleet and personal drivers.

exams.name: TRAA National Driver Certification Program
exams.body: Towing and Recovery Association of America
exams.blurb: Three-level towing certification covering light-duty, medium/heavy-duty and recovery operations with written and practical evaluations.

exams.name: TSA Hazardous Materials Endorsement Threat Assessment
exams.blurb: Federal fingerprint-based background check every commercial driver must clear before a state may issue a hazardous materials endorsement.

exams.name: WreckMaster Towing and Recovery Certification
exams.blurb: Graded towing and recovery certification covering rigging, winching, load calculation and rollover recovery for light through heavy-duty operators.

exams.name: Certified Global Business Professional
exams.blurb: Exam-based credential covering global business management, market research, supply chain management and trade finance.

exams.name: Certified Transportation Broker
exams.blurb: Examination for freight brokers covering broker-carrier agreements, liability, claims, credit management and federal brokerage regulation.

exams.name: Certified Transportation Professional
exams.blurb: Four-part examination for private fleet managers spanning equipment, operations, finance and human resource management.

exams.name: Certified Zone Specialist
exams.body: NCBFAA Educational Institute with the National Association of Foreign-Trade Zones
exams.blurb: Certification on United States Foreign-Trade Zone operations, admission procedures, inventory control and zone compliance requirements.

exams.name: Customs Broker License Examination
exams.blurb: Federal 80-question open-book examination held twice a year that applicants must pass to become a licensed customs broker.

exams.name: Export Compliance Professional Certification
exams.blurb: Specialist certification in EAR or ITAR export controls, licensing, classification and enforcement for trade compliance staff.

exams.name: FIATA Diploma in Freight Forwarding
exams.body: FIATA with the NCBFAA Educational Institute
exams.blurb: Internationally recognised freight forwarding diploma covering multimodal transport, documentation, insurance and incoterms.

exams.name: FRA Part 243 Safety-Related Railroad Employee Training
exams.blurb: Federal rule requiring railroads and contractors to qualify safety-related employees through approved training programmes and testing.

exams.name: National Transit Institute Roadway Worker Protection Training
exams.blurb: Rail transit training on right-of-way access, protection methods and hazard recognition for wayside workers and contractors.

exams.name: Public Transportation Safety Certification Training Program
exams.blurb: Federally mandated curriculum for state safety oversight staff and rail transit agency personnel with safety oversight responsibilities.

exams.name: Transit Safety and Security Program Certificate
exams.blurb: USDOT certificate programme for transit safety professionals covering system safety, security planning, emergency management and audits.
